notes.title: 🪲🌻🐝 Kabuto Park 1.1.0 "Thank you" update 🎁
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The game is out for two weeks now, and the reception is so amazing. I'm really touched by this.
As a thank you gift, here is little update with a new bug! Or maybe 2?!
It's nothing major but I hope you'll enjoy it.[/p][p]Feel free to use the Steam forums or Discord to report any bug you find or to give me some feedback![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]New common bug in Calm Lake: Sunburst Diving Beetle[/b]! It comes with a new attack card and a very cute shiny variant. This bug is a water bug, so you can now fill your terrarium completely with only unique bugs![/p][/*][*][p][b]Another new bug?![/b] This one is a secret, it's extra rare. Let the hunt begin![/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Balancing[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Tweaked rare and uncommon probabilities for Bugpedia lvl 3, 4 and 5. Before this, it was harder to find a specific uncommon than a specific rare. This fixes it![/p][/*][*][p]Common bugs that haven't been caught yet have a bit more chance of appearing than already caught ones.[/p][/*][*][p]"Cleanse" card now costs 1 instead of 3.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Bugs and fixes[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed "Copy Action" messing with some animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed music not fading out properly when transitioning to main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shop hover sounds triggering behind another window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stat number display when over 1000.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed nullref on keyboard shortcut during capture.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Other[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Added a shiny icon for bugs you caught as shiny in the "List" panel of map destinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Small animation on cards cost during battle to make it more visible when you have enough energy to play them.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements for catching all bugs in a region now have a progress bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Trying to sell a bug with 3 perfect stats from the bug panel will now ask you for confirmation. You can still sell them by mass selling, be careful.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now press space during battle to toggle pause.[/p][/*][*][p]Expended tooltip on calendar to explain how days pass.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] Have a nice day 💌[/p]

notes.title: 🪲🌻🐝 Kabuto Park 1.0.4 update 🧑‍🔧
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

That launch is crazy! We got the Overwhelmingly Positive rating on the store page extremely fast, and sales are going much much faster than I expected. Thanks to this I'll be able to continue my life as an indie dev! Thank you so much 💌
As always, a big thanks to people who reported bugs and issues on the Steam forums and on our discord. Here is a small update that fixes most of those.

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Excite" card now costs 6 instead of 5.
[*] Slight tweak to shiny probabilities. [spoiler] Shinies are slightly rarer than before in the late game but repeating spots with the max magnifier ability will boost the shiny chance slightly. This is a very small tweak but it will make it a tiny bit easier to find a specific shiny without making them feel less special. [/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed shiny Roly Poly sprites having the wrong size in some UI panels.
[*] Fixed achievements for catching all bugs in an area sometimes not triggering properly.
[*] Fixed another visual bug on number of bugs and candies when selling a large number of bugs at once.
[*] Fixed cards stacking in your hand if you used "Copy Action" after your opponent used "Amnesia".
[*] Fixed minor bug that would induce a tiny lag if you launched the game with a demo save that contained no bugs caught.
[*] Fixed typo on Roly Poly flavor text.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Save backup will now happen a bit more often after you finish the game.
[*] You cannot use honey during the animation after you caught or missed a bug.
[/list]

Thank you so much everyone for playing this little game 🪷

notes.title: 🪲🌻🐝 Kabuto Park 1.0.3 update 🧑‍🔧
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm extremely thankful for how the release is going. Reviews are so positive, and sales are much better than anticipated. We sold almost 6k copies in 24h and it's still going strong! 💖
A big thanks too to people who reported bugs and issues on the Steam forums and on our discord. Here is a small update that fixes most of those.

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Excited Flapping now costs 3 energy instead of 2.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a game breaking bug that could happen if you paused a fight with the top left button and went back to menu with the fight still paused.
[*] Fixed the deck panel appearing behind the opponent selection in post game, making it impossible to close it normally.
[*] Fixed weird dates on bugs brought from the demo.
[*] Fixed visual bugs on some big numbers (when selling a very large amount of bugs + other).
[*] Fixed terrarium sometimes duplicating bugs.
[*] Fixed terrarium info panel stuck open when quitting the terrarium with the panel open.
[*] Fixed typo on card "Small Tenacity" (was Tenactity)
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game will now do a backup save on every new in-game day. It's extremely rare and out of my control, but save corruption can happen if the game crashes for unknown reasons while saving. With this backup file I'll be able to help people if this happens.
[/list]

Thank you so much everyone for playing this little game 🪷

notes.title: Kabuto Park Demo 1.2.0 update 🧑‍🔧🪲✨
notes.content:
Hey everyone 🪲🐝☀️
Thank you so much for the hype around our tiny game!
This update focuses on the [b]save system[/b] and some [b]extremely rare bugs[/b] ✨

Feel free to use the Steam forums or Discord to report any bug you find or to give me some feedback!

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game now [b]saves [/b]automatically every time there is a transition screen! You can come back to see your awesome collection at any time now.
[*] Ultra rare [b]shiny [/b]bugs added to the game. Each bug in the demo now has its shiny variant with different colors and some nice sfx. They also usually have above average stats.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed Soothing Buzz by lowering cost.
[*] Buffed Calm Down by lowering duration.
[*] The last encounter with Doot (hey it's me!) is slightly harder and cooler.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed typo in name of Cerulean Chafer.
[*] Fixed duplicate sounds playing on top of each other.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bugs now have little shadows.
[/list]
Have a nice day 💌

notes.title: Kabuto Park Demo 1.1.0 update 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.content:
Hey everyone 🪲🐝☀️
I got some nice feedback on the demo, thanks a lot!
This update focuses on team selection and overall collection UX improvement.

Feel free to use the Steam forums or Discord to report any bug you find or give me some feedback!

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heavy rework of the team selection. You can now select or unselect bugs for your battle team without opening each bug panel. It's also easier to clear your whole team to select a new one.
[*] You can now sell multiple bugs at once directly from the collection by using a new quick action menu.
[*] New cute cursor.
[*] You can now catch bugs with the spacebar.
[*] You can now skip the post capture size bar animation by clicking anywhere or pressing the spacebar.
[*] The "new" tag will also appear in the bug panel the first time you look at bugs that you just caught.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Opposing team will now always get the first push. I'll work back on this for the full game but having it as random without a proper UI to show it felt bad and could lead to some underwhelming fights.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Kim's name (was called Jun 2)
[*] Fixed a typo. (specy => species)
[*] Fixed level up animation (title was not bouncing as expected)
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the "Battle Selected" icon for two cute little swords instead of a boring checkmark.
[*] Games now run in the background, music won't stop if you do something else like manage your chat while streaming.
[*] Removed "base stats" sort options from collection to keep things simple.
[*] Upgraded to latest Unity 2022.3.58f1 to avoid crashes during build and potential in game crashes.
[/list]
Have a nice day 💌
